facts_transferred.normal_seat_load: approximately 16 kip for paired trusses at 80 psf service gravity load

model_assumptions.hat_capacity_calibration: 6748 kip transfer divided by controlling outrigger E DCR 0.97 at 80 min; assumes linear scaling of that response path
model_assumptions.degraded_hat_cases: 75%, 50%, and absent cases are sensitivities, not observations
model_assumptions.unmet_transfer: any transfer above the imposed hat capacity is added back to total core compression
model_assumptions.seat_sampling: each synthetic floor-temperature sample is crossed with every NIST seat type because the actual seat-type/temperature map is unavailable
model_assumptions.core_redistribution: V8F local-four, local-eight, or global-capacity rule remains inside the core and is not yet component-bounded
